title: Stamped Carriage House
shortDesc: A traditional carriage house look pressed directly into steel for classic charm with low-profile, low-maintenance construction.
description:
The Stamped Carriage House brings timeless carriage-house character to your home without the upkeep of real wood. The carriage design is embossed straight into durable Nucor steel panels, so you get dimension and curb appeal in a streamlined, low-profile door.

Choose from a range of insulation options — uninsulated, polystyrene, or polyurethane up to R-16.55 — plus 9 solid colors and 9 woodtone finishes. Oversized window options and multiple glass finishes round out the look, all backed by a limited lifetime warranty and made in the USA.

title: Raised Panel
shortDesc: The timeless best-seller — elevated rectangular panels that add depth and dimension, in short or long panel styles.
description:
C.H.I.'s Raised Panel is the classic garage door that fits nearly any home. Elevated rectangular panels add subtle depth and dimension, and you can choose short or long panel layouts to match your home's proportions.

Built from durable Nucor steel in thicknesses from 1.5" to 2" with standard, medium, or heavy-duty gauges, it offers five insulation levels up to R-17.19. Finish it in 10 solid colors or 9 woodtone options, all with a low-maintenance finish and limited lifetime coverage.

title: Stamped Shaker
shortDesc: Clean, minimalist lines with embossed shaker detailing for a timeless, modern-leaning look.
description:
The Stamped Shaker collection pairs clean, simple lines with subtle embossed detailing for a look that feels both timeless and contemporary. Oversized window options let you bring in more light and elevate the design.

Available in 1-sided steel, 1-sided steel with vinyl backing, or 2-sided steel at 2" thick, with insulation ranging from uninsulated up to R-16.55 polyurethane. Choose from 9 solid colors plus 9 woodtone finishes, including accent and natural-wood selections.

title: Planks
shortDesc: Ultra-realistic wood-grain finishes on steel — the wood look without the wood maintenance.
description:
Planks delivers the warmth of natural wood with the durability of steel. Ultra-realistic wood-grain finishes give you authentic plank character while shrugging off the maintenance demands of real timber.

Each 2" panel is built from 27-gauge two-sided steel in medium or heavy-duty variants, with polystyrene (R-10.29) or polyurethane (R-17.54) insulation. Pick from 9 solid colors and 7 woodtone finishes, plus short, long, and oversized window options in a variety of glass styles. Made in the USA.

title: Shoreline
shortDesc: Wood-look overlay carriage doors with authentic faux-wood style and steel durability.
description:
Shoreline is C.H.I.'s wood-look carriage house door, using overlay panels to capture authentic faux-wood aesthetics while keeping the low-maintenance benefits of steel.

Sections are a substantial 2.5" thick in two-sided 27-gauge steel with R-17.54 polyurethane insulation for real energy efficiency. Eight finishes are available, including single-tone woodtones and striking two-tone combinations, with carriage-style window options. Backed by a limited lifetime section warranty.

title: Full-View Aluminum
shortDesc: Expansive glass in a lightweight aluminum frame for a sleek, contemporary, ultra-modern statement.
description:
The Full-View Aluminum door makes a bold modern statement with expansive glass panels set in a lightweight, corrosion-resistant aluminum frame. It's a favorite for contemporary homes and indoor-outdoor living spaces.

Choose the uninsulated Model 3295 or the insulated Model 3297 (R-3.07 polystyrene), with frosted, obscure, plain, or tinted glass. Finish options include 9 solid colors, clear anodized, 4 woodtones, and 188 additional powder-coat colors — plus an STC 27 noise rating and a limited lifetime section warranty.
